worktrees.agent.badPlacement: The panes can't be placed like that in this layout.
worktrees.agent.badWorkflowRole: A role in the workflow is builder, reviewer, either, generalist or independent.
worktrees.agent.chooseMove: Choose where to move the agent.
worktrees.agent.effortRefused: {chosen, select, yes {{model}} other {The CLI's default model}} doesn't take {effort} effort. Choose one of the levels it takes.
worktrees.agent.nameTaken: There is already an agent called "{name}".
worktrees.agent.noTree: This agent works in the project folder, not a worktree.
worktrees.agent.notPinned: Agents aren’t pinned to worktrees in 1.0: slots are lent per card or lane.
worktrees.agent.providerChangedMeanwhile: {agent}'s provider was changed meanwhile: nothing was changed. Try again.
worktrees.agent.removing: That worktree is already being removed or merged.
worktrees.agent.roleTooLong: A role is at most {max} characters.
worktrees.agent.sharedTree: Another agent already works in that worktree.
worktrees.agent.stopForProvider: Stop the agent before changing its provider.
worktrees.agent.stopToMerge: Stop {agent} before merging and removing its worktree.
worktrees.agent.stopToRemove: Stop the agent before removing it.
worktrees.badBranchName: "{branch}" is not a valid branch name.
worktrees.branchInWay: Git can't make the branch {branch}: a branch {parent} is in the way. Choose another branch.
worktrees.merge.cantCheck: Git couldn't check the worktree for uncommitted changes (git status failed in {folder}). Fix it, then merge again.
worktrees.merge.caseAlias: The branches {branch} and {other} differ only in case, which Windows can't tell apart, so nothing was merged. Rename one of them, then merge.
worktrees.merge.detached: The project folder is not on a branch (detached HEAD). Check out the branch to merge into first.
worktrees.merge.hooksElsewhere: If one of the repository's hooks refused it: they ran in a temporary checkout of {branch}, which has none of the project folder's untracked files (node_modules, say). Check out {branch} in the project folder and merge there to run them with everything in place.
worktrees.merge.noTarget: There is no branch {branch} to merge into.
worktrees.merge.notRemoved: Merged, but the worktree was not removed
worktrees.merge.sameBranch: The project folder has {branch} checked out.
worktrees.merge.staged: The project folder has staged changes. Commit or unstage them before merging.
worktrees.merge.targetElsewhere: {branch} is checked out in {folder}. Merge there, or check out another branch in that folder first.
worktrees.merge.targetMoved: {branch} changed while Combwork was merging into it. Nothing was merged: merge again.
worktrees.merge.temporaryLeft: Combwork couldn't remove its temporary folder {folder}: remove it in Unused worktrees.
worktrees.merge.uncommitted: Nothing was merged: {files, plural, one {# file in the worktree isn't committed} other {# files in the worktree aren't committed}}. Commit or stash {files, plural, one {it} other {them}} in the worktree, then merge.
worktrees.missing.noBranch: {agent}'s branch {branch} is gone, and the project folder isn't on a branch to start a new one from.
worktrees.missing.slotFailed: Slot {slot} of agent {agent} couldn't be made again: {why}
worktrees.missing.stillListed: git still lists {folder} as a worktree (it may be locked): unlock it, or run git worktree prune, then try again.
worktrees.missing.thereRecreate: {agent}'s worktree folder is there ({folder}): there's nothing to recreate.
worktrees.missing.thereUnlink: {agent}'s worktree folder is there ({folder}): remove the agent to remove its worktree.
worktrees.missing.wouldPrune: Recreating runs git worktree prune, which would also drop git's link to {folders} (missing too). Locate, recreate or remove {n, plural, one {that worktree} other {those worktrees}} first.
worktrees.names.closed: The workspace was closed or switched: nothing was changed.
worktrees.names.projectGone: That project is no longer in the workspace.
worktrees.readBranch: git couldn't read the branch checked out in {folder} ({why})
worktrees.reuse.notMerged: {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} not merged into {base}
worktrees.reuse.uncommitted: {n, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
worktrees.statusFailed: git status failed in its folder
worktrees.why.mainMoved: {gone, select, yes {the main branch is gone, not {expected} as checked} other {the main branch is {now}, not {expected} as checked}}
worktrees.why.noMain: the repository has no main branch (main or master) to check it against
worktrees.why.notListed: git doesn't list it as a worktree on {branch}
worktrees.why.notMerged: {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} not merged into {into}
worktrees.why.uncommitted: {n, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
